How are you, Speaky?
I'm HAPPY! Happy, happy —
sunny and snappy!
😊 I'm great!
How are you, Speaky?

How are you, Speaky?
I'm TIRED! Yawn, yawn —

😴 zzz…
How are you, Speaky?

🥶 So cold!
How are you, Speaky?

Coco gives a kiss!
Now I'm HAPPY — nothing better than this!
🐶 Woof! 🦝 Ha ha!

How do you feel? — I feel happy!
How are you? — I'm happy!
